SOURCE & CONTEXT

Demonstration dataset

All 24 events are fictional fixtures, separate from GTD records.

Bubble area represents the selected known total. Groups aggregate nearby events. The scale adjusts to the map view; compare values using the legend and tooltip. Small positive values have a minimum visible radius. Hollow markers identify zero totals; dashed markers identify entirely unknown totals.

Records without coordinates remain in summaries and the event list. Map movement does not change filtered totals.
